A newline inside two nested spans still separates the words on either side

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p>Alpha<span><span>\n</span></span>Beta</p>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
